name: frc-toolkit
description: Helps FIRST Robotics (FRC) teams debug robots with an AI assistant: live robot data, match logs, simulation, Systemcore and CTRE devices.

nt4_host.title: NetworkTables host
nt4_host.description: Robot or simulator address. 127.0.0.1 is the simulator on this computer.

systemcore_host.title: Systemcore address
systemcore_host.description: Leave empty to find it automatically (Wi-Fi: 172.30.0.1).

diag_host.title: Controller address for CTRE diagnostics
diag_host.description: Where the Phoenix Diagnostic Server runs. Empty means the Systemcore's own Wi-Fi address, 172.30.0.1.

nt4_read_only.title: NetworkTables read-only
nt4_read_only.description: On: never write to the robot. Applies to every project. Off alone does not allow writes: see docs/SETTINGS.md.

read_outside_logs.title: Read logs from other folders
read_outside_logs.description: On: the assistant may open a .wpilog or Driver Station log, or list a folder of them, outside the project folder (for example a USB stick). Claude Code asks you first, each time. Reading only, and only log files.

allow_record.title: Allow recording Java programs with JFR
allow_record.description: On: the assistant may attach to a running Java program and record it. Reading recordings always works. Applies to every project, so turn it off after use.

allow_deploy.title: Allow deploying code to the robot
allow_deploy.description: On: the assistant may deploy robot code (it still asks you first). Applies to every project, so turn it off after use.

allow_prune.title: Allow deleting Systemcore logs
allow_prune.description: On: the assistant may delete old logs on the Systemcore (a dry run and a counted confirmation still apply). Applies to every project, so turn it off after use.

allow_provision.title: Allow installing the SSH key on the Systemcore
allow_provision.description: On: the assistant may install this server's SSH key on the Systemcore (it asks you first). Applies to every project, so turn it off after use.

allow_wifi_join.title: Allow joining the Systemcore Wi-Fi from this computer
allow_wifi_join.description: On: the assistant may join or leave the robot Wi-Fi, which drops your current Wi-Fi (it asks you first). Applies to every project, so turn it off after use.

allow_restart.title: Allow restarting robot code and rebooting the Systemcore
allow_restart.description: On: the assistant may restart robot code or reboot the Systemcore (it asks first, and never while the robot is enabled). Applies to every project, so turn it off after use.

allow_ctre_install.title: Allow installing CTRE tools
allow_ctre_install.description: On: the assistant may download CTRE tools such as Owlet from CTRE's website (it asks you first). Applies to every project, so turn it off after use.

allow_caniv_config.title: Allow renaming or resetting a CANivore
allow_caniv_config.description: On: the assistant may rename or reset a CANivore (it asks you first). Applies to every project, so turn it off after use.

allow_caniv_flash.title: Allow flashing CANivore firmware
allow_caniv_flash.description: On: the assistant may flash firmware onto a CANivore (it asks you first). Applies to every project, so turn it off after use.

learning_mode.title: Learning mode
learning_mode.description: On: some tool replies add a short tip, such as why something works or something interesting, to help a student learn what they are looking at. Off: short answers only. Applies to every project.
